artifact_policy: Missing artifacts or hashes block readiness.

doctrine: No Coupa access, browser open, portal login, or submit without every proof, secret, approval, provider, and authority gate.
Default and fixture modes never call browser/Coupa providers.
Generic chat approval is not enough for high-consequence Coupa submit.
Missing gates produce a human blocked reason and how_to_fix.

fail_closed_policy: Unknown provider, unknown mode, raw credential marker, raw PO marker, generic approval, or missing gate fails closed.
Tests must prove no provider call, no browser, and submitted=false.
guardian_policy: Guardian approval ref is required for submit readiness.
Approval execution does not happen here.

invoice_value_policy: Invoice values must include confirmed dates, rate, and subtotal refs.
Values come from receipts/readbacks/source refs, not chat phrases.
adapter.next_safe_move: Use DRY_RUN_ONLY or READINESS_CHECK_ONLY until a future Coupa/browser provider adapter is explicitly gated.
operator_approval_policy: Exact operator approval receipt must bind to this package/covenant.
Generic phrases such as submit it, yes, or go ahead are blocked.
po_reference_policy: PO/reference must be confirmed by protected/source refs.
Candidate or missing PO blocks submit readiness.
Raw PO strings are blocked from generated outputs unless represented as safe refs.
secret_policy: Protected Coupa credential refs are required for any future portal login.
Raw credentials are never accepted as gate satisfaction.
source_package_policy: Coupa supplier portal package ref must identify the exact package under review.
Run package ref binds Coupa submit to the invoice delivery workflow.
Missing package refs block submit readiness.
submit_receipt_policy: Submit receipt is modeled with submitted=false in this lane.
Provider confirmation ref is absent unless a future gated live submit occurs.
Final completion cannot be claimed without receipt refs.
